description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) ARMOURED IMPACT (Gravis Linebreaker Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privilege: the Kommandos placed ~3" in front of the Eradicator Squad with Heavy Bolters (GRAVIS). The charge tools' actions (DECLARE_CHARGE, a seeded CHARGE_ROLL, the engine charge-move solver) make the Eradicators end a charge move engaged with the Kommandos; unit_ended_charge_move opens; a real click on Use and on the secondary pick (the engaged Kommandos) spend 1 CP; one D6 per Eradicator model engaged with the Kommandos, each 3+ is 1 mortal wound (Game Log names the dice).

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force
